catalog.author: Wassim Oukoudda
catalog.story: 2041: ORACLE controls a fictional city's machines. The resistance follows isolated missions toward the final Maze kill switch.
catalog.scope: Presentation catalog only. All missions are fictional isolated simulations or offline datasets. This organizer does not provision labs, scan networks, build exploits or control devices. Difficulty, points, capacity and prerequisites are proposed organizer defaults, not facts from the brief.

missions.title: Warehouse / Logistics Bots
missions.goal: Recover the fictional fleet's dispatch manifest by reviewing a mock dashboard and an offline application trace.

missions.title: Quadruped Patrol Dogs
missions.goal: Interpret a supplied toy firmware image and prerecorded debug dump to recover a fictional maintenance clue.

missions.title: Humanoid Soldiers
missions.goal: Reconstruct the intended movement sequence from a mock motion API transcript and captured simulation messages.

missions.title: Drones — Virtual UAV Swarm
missions.goal: Identify inconsistent synthetic telemetry and restore coordination in a fictional simulator scenario; no radio or real flight actions.

missions.title: Medical / Surgical Robots
missions.goal: Protect entirely fabricated patient records and reason about a toy safety interlock in an isolated medical simulation.

missions.title: Autonomous Vehicles
missions.goal: Analyze an offline fictional CAN capture and supplied sensor traces to explain a simulated route discrepancy.

missions.title: Industrial Arms — Factory
missions.goal: Read a toy production-logic artifact and identify the safe intended sequence for a simulated robot arm.

missions.title: Elevator Tower
missions.goal: Solve progressively harder mock panel, prerecorded protocol, firmware-puzzle and door-logic clues to reach a fictional rooftop flag.
missions.note: Separated from the ambiguous plant heading in the uploaded brief; this is its own tower mission.

missions.title: Fictional Nuclear Plant — Safe Shutdown
missions.goal: Restore a safe abstract state in a made-up dashboard puzzle and select its fictional shutdown win condition. No real reactor design, control parameters, procedures or interfaces are supplied.

missions.title: ORACLE’s Eyes
missions.goal: Review generated camera frames, toy firmware clues and prerecorded stream artifacts to identify a fictional empty-corridor decoy.

missions.title: Descend to Ring 0 (and below)
missions.goal: Interpret isolated mock privilege-boundary and toy escape puzzles as a staged narrative; no working privilege escalation or escape payload is included.
missions.note: Negative ring labels are narrative shorthand, not a universal CPU privilege architecture. No exploit lab is built by this package.

missions.title: The Blind Spot
missions.goal: Find a brief prerecorded docking interval and reassemble synthetic footage chunks from an offline sync trace.
missions.note: The robot is intermittently connected at a dock, not genuinely permanently air-gapped. Timing is represented by supplied artifacts, not live monitoring.

missions.title: Through the Walls
missions.goal: Decode a fictional movement path from synthetic CSI/RSSI time-series artifacts. No live RF collection, people tracking or hardware interaction.

missions.title: The Maze — Final Kill Switch
missions.goal: Distinguish ORACLE's fictional core from shifting decoys in a supplied toy graph and select the narrative kill-switch endpoint; no live Kubernetes access, cluster takeover or container escape is implemented.
missions.note: Eligibility also requires the configured minimum number of completed main missions (default 3, excluding the warehouse).
